text_en: King Hiram of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar logs, and masons and carpenters to build a house for him.
text_cn: 提洛王希兰派使臣来见达味，给他送来香柏木，派来石匠和木工，为他建筑宫室。

text_en: David then perceived that the Lord had established him as king over Israel, and that his kingdom was highly exalted for the sake of his people Israel.
text_cn: 那时，达味知道上主已确定他为以色列王，并为了自己的百姓以色列，提高了他的王位。

text_en: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
text_cn: 达味在耶路撒冷又娶了妻室，生了许多子女。

text_en: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, and Nathan; Solomon,
text_cn: 达味在耶路撒冷所生儿子的名字如下：沙慕亚、芍巴布、纳堂、撒罗满、
依贝哈尔、厄里叔亚、厄里培肋特、
厄里沙玛、贝里雅达和厄里培肋特。

text_en: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up in search of David; and David heard of it and went out against them.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人听说达味受傅，为全以色列王，遂都上来向达味寻衅。达味听说，便出来迎击。

text_en: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人上来侵入了勒法因平原。

text_en: David inquired of God, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you give them into my hand? ” The Lord said to him, “Go up, and I will give them into your hand. ”
text_cn: 那时，达味求问天主说：“我可以上去攻打培肋舍特人吗？你将他们交在我手中吗？”上主答应他说：“你上去，我必将他们交在你手中。”

text_en: So he went up to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, “God has burst out against my enemies by my hand, like a bursting flood. ” Therefore that place is called Baal-perazim.
text_cn: 达味于是上到巴耳培辣亲，在那里击败了他们。达味因此说：“天主假我的手使我的敌人崩溃，如水破堤。”因此后人称这地方为巴耳培辣亲。

text_en: They abandoned their gods there, and at David’s command they were burned.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人把自己的神像都遗弃在那里，达味命人用火烧毁。

text_en: Once again the Philistines made a raid in the valley.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人又侵入平原。

text_en: When David again inquired of God, God said to him, “You shall not go up after them; go around and come on them opposite the balsam trees.
text_cn: 达味又求问天主，天主对他说：“不要一直上去追击他们，要绕到他们后方，从桑林那边抄他们的后路。

text_en: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike down the army of the Philistines. ”
text_cn: 你一听见桑树梢上有脚步声，要即刻出战，因为天主在你前面出击培肋舍特人的军队。”

text_en: David did as God had commanded him, and they struck down the Philistine army from Gibeon to Gezer.
text_cn: 达味就照天主所命的行了，击杀培肋舍特人的军队，由基贝红直到革则尔。

text_en: The fame of David went out into all lands, and the Lord brought the fear of him on all nations.
text_cn: 因此，达味的声名传遍了各地，上主使各民族都害怕他。
